steps.text: A secret message is hidden on the paper — written with an invisible basic solution. Let's reveal it with an indicator!
Tap “Spray!” to spray the indicator across the paper.
Watch closely — where the indicator meets the base, it changes colour and the hidden message appears.
That's the power of acid–base indicators: they change colour to reveal substances we can't see. Spies once used this trick with invisible ink!

coach.mission: Reveal the hidden message with the indicator.
whenStuck: Tap “Spray!” to spray the indicator across the paper.
The message appears where the indicator meets the basic ink.
whenWrong: Indicators change colour only where they meet a base — spray and watch closely.
The invisible ink is basic; that's why the indicator reacts there.
whenCorrect: Nice — the indicator revealed the hidden base!
That's how indicators expose substances we can't see.
coach.done: You've seen an indicator reveal a hidden base. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
